Postmark.//: Shared secret for POST /api/inbound-email/postmark. Postmark sends it via the webhook URL (?token= or Basic auth), NOT a header. Set the real value as Inbound__Postmark__WebhookToken in the environment.
Postmark.//InboundDomain: Preferred local-part addressing: {slug}@orders.proculink.eu — set this to the single inbound domain (one MX record). Leave empty to use the legacy subdomain scheme.
Postmark.//HostSuffix: Legacy subdomain scheme suffix (default .proculink.eu) for orders@{token}.proculink.eu — needs a wildcard MX.

Inbound.//LegacyAddressGraceDays: Days a backfilled legacy SLUG inbound address keeps working before it expires. Default 90. Tenant selection now runs on org_inbound_addresses, not on the org slug; the backfill registers each existing org's slug as an EXPIRING address so mail already in flight survives the deploy. Shorten to retire the guessable scheme sooner; the founder can also revoke per tenant from Settings.
